nodes.rationale: Akari-OS and AkariOS-Ultimate were two halves of one product with duplicated tweaks; monolithic files burn AI tokens. Goal: adding or fixing a tweak touches one small file.

nodes.rationale: A legacy Toggle with unknown State can still be reverted before it is ported.
